info.title: Alchemy Solana JSON-RPC Specification
info.description: A specification of the standard JSON-RPC methods for Solana.

methods.name: getAsset
methods.description: Returns information about a single digital asset.

params.name: Asset ID
params.description: The ID of the asset to retrieve.

schema.title: Asset ID
schema.description: The ID of the asset, typically a base-58 encoded string.

params.name: Configuration
params.description: Optional configuration object for display formatting.

result.name: Asset information
result.description: Returns detailed information about the specified digital asset.

id.title: Asset ID
id.description: The ID of the asset, typically a base-58 encoded string.

json_uri.description: The URI of the JSON metadata.

cdn_uri.description: The CDN URI of the file.

mime.description: The MIME type of the file.

trait_type.description: The trait type of the attribute.

links.description: External links related to the asset.

eligible.description: Whether the asset is eligible for compression.

data_hash.description: The data hash of the compressed asset.

creator_hash.description: The creator hash of the compressed asset.

asset_hash.description: The asset hash of the compressed asset.

leaf_id.description: The leaf ID in the merkle tree.

primary_sale_happened.description: Whether the primary sale has happened.

delegate.description: The delegate of the asset, if any.

methods.name: getAssetsByOwner
methods.description: Returns assets owned by the specified address.

params.name: Owner address
params.description: The owner address to filter assets by.

params.name: Configuration
params.description: Optional configuration object for sorting and pagination.

sortBy.description: The field to sort by. Note: Only `id` is supported for cursor-based pagination (using `before`/`after`). Sorting by `created`, `updated`, `recentAction`, or `none` requires page-based pagination (using `page`).

limit.description: The maximum number of assets to retrieve.

page.description: The index of the "page" to retrieve. Required when using sortBy values other than `id`.

before.description: Retrieve assets before this cursor. Only supported when sortBy is `id`.

after.description: Retrieve assets after this cursor. Only supported when sortBy is `id`.

result.name: Assets by owner
result.description: Returns assets owned by the specified address.
